A young orphan was alone in the world until he meets the master of a secret form of martial arts. To learn these otherworldly techniques, he will need to endure years of his sadistic teacher’s grueling and weird training. But why does he have to do laundry, cook meals, or play instruments to learn martial arts anyway?! If he can survive long enough (and if his massive ego doesn’t get in the way), he just might be able to wield the unstoppable lightning knives. Will he make the cut or be sliced down to size?

5歳の時母親が亡くなり、10歳の時伝染病で父親まで亡くなった少年「飛雲」。彼は彫刻家だった父からその才能を受け継いでいた。 両親の木像を作り、二人の墓の前にそなえたある日、それを見た老人から「自分を師匠にすれば天下一の武術を教えよう」と話しかけられる。怪しいとは思ったものの老人が見せた武術に惹かれその申し出を受けてしまった飛雲。案の定、武術などろくに教えず、訓練といいながら家事と金稼ぎばかり… そんなある日、女装して働いている酒楼で偶然武林盟主の娘である「羅 香凜」の命を救った。飛雲は男であることを隠して香凜と親しくなるが…

description.ko:
홀로 길러주신 아버지를 돌림병으로 잃고 10세의 어린 나이에 혈혈단신이 된 비류연.
조각가였던 아버지에게 배운 기술로 부모님의 조각상을 만들어 두 분의 묘 앞에 세워두는데,
지나가던 노인이 그걸 보더니 자신을 사부로 삼으면 천하제일 무공을 가르쳐주겠다고 한다.

수상쩍지만 달리 갈 곳도 없고, 그럴듯해 보이는 무공에 혹해 비류연은 그를 따라가고 마는데…

그날 이후 비류연을 길러준 것은 팔할이 바람이었다.

오늘 하루는 좀 편안했으면 좋겠다는 바람!
사부가 더 늙으면 울 때까지 구박해주겠다는 바람!
아니 다 필요 없고 여기서 탈출하고 싶다는 바람!
하늘이여 저한테 왜 이러세요 제발 살려주세요… 하는 바람!

하늘이 비류연의 바람을 들어준 것일까.
무식한 가사노동과 피골상접 과로사를 야기할 것 같던 돈벌이로 점철된 삶 속에서
깨알같이 사부 몰래 힘을 비축하던 비류연은 드디어 어느 날 깨닫는다.

‘오늘이 바로 그날이다!’

사부를 따돌릴 꿀떡(?)을 던져놓고는 무한한 용기를 발휘해 묵금과 비뢰도까지 다 들고 튄 비류연.

혹자는 강호를 두고 시산혈해 위에 암투로 쌓아올린 백척간두의 세계라고 하나,
비류연에겐 드넓은 꿀 천지에 온실 속의 화초들이 노니는 안락한 신세계로만 보였는데…!

비류연의 행복은 과연 언제까지 갈 것인가!

description.ru:
В 10 лет Би Рю Ён становится сиротой, потеряв последнего родственника, своего отца.

Будучи хорошим сыном и отличным подмастерьем весьма талантливого ремесленника, он решает соорудить две прекрасные статуи в память о своих родителях. Так, когда работа была практически завершена, к нему неожиданно обратился некий старый мастер, пожелав стать наставником парня, и обещая обучить самому могущественному искусству во всей Поднебесной.

Жажда до силы превозмогает сомнения. И он решает последовать за стариком… 

С этого момента... жизнь круто изменилась. Невыносимые тренировки и серьезные наказания следовали по пятам день за днём! Иногда казалось, труд настолько изматывал мальчика, что кожа прилипала к костям, а смерть от переутомления уже маячила на горизонте. Много раз Рю Ён хотел бросить всё и покинуть наставника. Возгласы, «О Небо, за что мне всё это?! Кто-нибудь, спасите меня!» - не сходили с его уст. Но Небеса оставались безмолвны.

И вот, в один из множества преисполненных изнеможением и страданиями дней, когда сил осталось с кунжутное зёрнышка, он понял: «Это оно!»

Сегодня Рю Ён превзойдёт своего учителя и узнает, что такое "Меч разящего грома".

description.en:
Being a character of your favorite game is great! Sure, he’s just a minor NPC, but Corin knows this game like the back of his hand. With his knowledge and the main player Sihu’s abilities, everything’s going smoothly - until Corin discovers Sihu’s been murdering innocent NPCs and stealing their items. 

Horrified but powerless to stop him, Corin awaits the end of the game - only for Sihu to mysteriously fail at the last mission. 

Instantly, Corin travels three years back in time. Now, he’s determined to kill Sihu and take on his role - defeat the final boss and save the world.

description.ru: Протагонист, человек с земли, попадает в статиста из игры, в которую он играл, но кое-кто ещё так же попал в главного героя игры. Они объединились и стали работать вместе, чтобы дойти до финала и победить Короля Демонов, но человек, попавший в главного героя оказывается психопатом, убивавшим персонажей ради снаряжения, прочей выгоды и просто удовольствия. Перед битвой с Королём Демонов это раскрывается и он запирает протагониста, отправляясь в одиночку убивать Короля Демонов. Сидя взаперти протагонист видит системное сообщение, в котором говорится, что битва с Королём Демонов проиграна. Спустя мгновение он оказывается перенесённым в прошлое, в первый день попадания в этот мир. Теперь он намерен убить главного героя и спасти мир.

description.en:
Primabelle is astonished when she wakes up to find herself in a novel of her own creation as an obscure painter who gets killed by the male protagonist, Prince Rainsis. 

The world she created has not been kind to Rainsis. In addition to being colorblind, he has been shunned and feared his entire life, for a prophecy had been made that “the one trapped in a black and white world shall drench the empire in blood.” Primabelle resolves to disprove the prophecy after witnessing his misery firsthand. 

To do so, she must track down his destined other half. The only problem? All she knows about the fair beauty is that she has black hair and crimson eyes. Will Primabelle be able to help Rainsis see the world in all its splendid colors and find true happiness?
description.es:
Si no hay "Belleza" en "La Bella y la Bestia", entonces, ¿quién levantará la maldición de la Bestia?  
  
"Un día, alguien atrapado en un mundo en blanco y negro aparecerá y manchará tu mundo de sangre".  
  
Gracias a esta profecía, la "Bestia", el príncipe Reynsis, fue abandonado y abandonado para que se las arreglara solo. Para deshacer la maldición, necesita la "Belleza", pero el único problema es …  
"¡¿Quién diablos se supone que es esta Belleza ?!"  
  
¡Reencarné en mi propia novela incompleta antes de escribir sobre la apariencia de la belleza! Todo lo que sé sobre la "Bella" es que tiene el pelo negro y los ojos carmesí … pero después de presenciar la infortunada infancia del príncipe Reynsis de primera mano, ¡resolví ir a buscar la belleza de la Bestia yo mismo!
description.fr:
Si la "Belle" n'existait pas dans "La Belle et la Bête", à qui reviendrait-il de lever la malédiction de ladite Bête ?  
  
"Un jour, quelqu'un enfermé dans un monde monochrome apparaitra, et teintera le vôtre de votre sang."  
  
Grâce à cette prophétie, la "Bête", le prince Reynsis, fut abandonné et dû se débrouiller seul. Afin de contrer la malédiction, il a besoin de la "Belle",  
seulement, le problème est que—  
"Qui est supposée être cette Belle, au juste ?!"  
  
Je me suis réincarnée dans mon propre roman non terminé avant même que je n'écrive l'arrivée de la Belle ! Tout ce que je sais de la "Belle", c'est qu'elle a des cheveux brun et des yeux cramoisis… Mais après avoir été témoin de l'enfance malheureuse du prince Reynsis, j'ai décidé d'aller chercher la belle de la Bête moi-même !  
  


---
description.ru:
Если в «Красавица и чудовище» так и не появится прекрасная дева, кто избавит зверя от проклятия?  
«Появится человек, запертый в черно-белом мире, и окрасит вашу жизнь кровью.»  
«Зверь Ренсис» - 8й принц Империи и дитя из пророчества, чье проклятие способна развеять лишь «красавица».  
Став свидетелем печального детства подростка, безымянная художница Примабель, чья судьба – стать жертвой «Зверя», решила:  
«Я лично найду красотку для принца!»  
  


---
description.pt-br: Se não houver "Beleza" em "A Bela e a Besta", quem eliminará a maldição da Besta? "Um dia, alguém preso em um mundo de preto e branco aparecerá e manchará seu mundo com sangue." Graças a esta profecia, a "Besta", Príncipe Reynsis, foi abandonado e deixado para se defender sozinho. Para desfazer a maldição, ele precisa da "Beleza", mas o único problema é "Quem diabos é essa beleza supostamente ?!" Eu reencarnei em meu próprio romance incompleto antes de escrever sobre a aparência da bela! Tudo o que sei sobre a "Bela" é que ela tem cabelo preto e olhos vermelhos ... mas depois de testemunhar a infeliz infância do Príncipe Reynsis em primeira mão, resolvi ir e encontrar a beleza da Fera eu mesma!

description.en:
Eris Miserian just wants to die.

Being overworked and underappreciated in the real world wasn’t great, but living as the villainess in a romance novel is even worse. If Eris can die in the novel, she might be able to return to reality, but the story won’t let her. Desperate to escape a life as the protagonist’s tormentor, she sets off on a journey with the help of a witch, a knight, and a high priest. Can she find her way back to her friends and family, or is Eris doomed to a fictional future?

description.ru:
Она перевоплотилась в злодейку из романа.  
Эрис испила яд, когда ее бывший жених, наследный принц, женился на ее подруге детства, служанке Елене. Когда я осознала, что произошло, у меня появилась только одна цель: сбежать из этого вымышленного мира. Но мир не позволил, и мне пришлось измениться. Это привело к тому, что те, кто игнорировал оригинальную Эрис, вдруг стали выпрашивать внимания и ласки у "новой" ее.  
— Кто ты? — спросил святой, который лелеял Елену.  
— Ты… ты действительно Эрис? — спросил воин, который поклялся в вечной верности Елене.  
— …Ты изменилась, — сказал даже принц, который отверг оригинальную Эрис ради Елены.  
Это странно. Все вы никогда не интересовались Эрис, так почему делаете это сейчас? Но даже так, я не стану привязываться, сколько бы времени ни прошло. Я никогда не полюблю этот мир.

As a powerful 8th class mage, Ian Paige took countless innocent lives under the orders of Emperor Ragnar, a close friend and ruler of the Greenriver Empire. Yet despite their closeness, Ragnar views Ian as a threat and subsequently poisons him. 

Using time magic, Ian saves himself and returns 30 years to the past. Now a young boy, Ian joins an elite order of mages to hone his abilities once again.

 This time, he’ll get revenge on the emperor who betrayed him and reclaim glory as an 8th class mage!

description.it:
Dopo decine di anni passate in sanguinose guerre l'imperatore Ragnar incontra il suo vecchio amico, ritiratosi ad una vita di solitudine e esilio nella città natale, nell'intento di espiare i propri peccati. Ad un mago potente sarà concesso il lusso di ritirarsi in esilio? Con un tradimento ha fine una lunga amicizia. Però, prima che la morte sopraggiunga, esiste la possibilità di rimediare ad ogni peccato. Attraverso un balzo nel tempo di oltre 30 anni il potente mago cercherà di ribaltare le sorti del futuro.

description.ko:
황제 라그나르와 통일 제국을 위해 손에 피를 묻히길 수십 년.
나는 고향으로 돌아가 속죄하며 죽은 듯이 살고자 했다.

그러나,

“자네는 언제든지 나를, 나의 제국을 집어삼킬 수 있는 8클래스의 대마법사.”
“그런 괴물을 어찌 살려둘 수가 있겠나?”

친구이자 주군이었던 라그나르에게 배신당하고 죽음의 문턱을 넘기 직전,
시간 마법의 주문이 새겨진 단검을 심장에 찔러 넣었다.

‘내가 원했던 참회란, 모든 것을 되돌려놓는 것.’


인류 최초의 8클래스 마법사 이안 페이지.
그가 30년 전 과거로 돌아왔다.

description.ru:
История рассказывает об Иане Пэйдже, архимаге и первом человеке, который прорвался через уровень шестого класса, а затем и седьмого, став самым могущественным магом восьмого класса.

После целой жизни, состоящей из войн и убийств, он сумел окончательно объединить континент. Состарившись, единственными его желаниями стали стремление прожить остаток жизни в мире и попытки найти спасение от горестей, привнесённых пролитой им кровью. Тем не менее его старый друг, обезумев от паранойи, не мог спокойно сосуществовать рядом с кем-то настолько сильным и предал Иана, убив его.

На последнем издыхании Иан использовал магию времени, которая переместила его в прошлое, в то время, когда он был маленьким мальчиком. Имея при себе все свои знания из прошлого, Иан решил сделать нечто большее, чтобы просто прожить жизнь с меньшим количеством сожалений.

“My favorite one will become the male empress.”

description.en:
Hunter Cha Euijae, sent to seal a rift over the West Sea, was flung out after closing it. When he regain consciousness, he found himself in a garbage dump — eight years in the future.

Starving, he stumbled into a hangover soup restaurant and realized the world had changed. Now, disaster alerts warn of rift openings, slime ASMR videos are trending, and hunters livestream A-rank sword unboxings. Instead of the looming apocalypse, the future is oddly peaceful, leaving Cha Euijae feeling empty. 

Deciding to leave his hunter days behind, he chooses to work part-time at the restaurant. But his quiet new life takes a turn when he meets a mysterious figure in a gas mask…

description.en:
An arranged marriage that ends in a body swap?! The quiet Princess Elissa has lived a miserable life thus far. To get away from it all she agrees to marry the war tyrant, Duke Ginger of Landall Kingdom. But by some evil curse, the new couple wakes up in each other's bodies! Between royal functions to attend and getting used to their physical changes, can they keep their cool long enough to find a way to switch back? Or will they be stuck like this forever?! Based on the hit novel.

A catastrophe, a zombie virus, hit the Earth. Three years to survive a devastating and desperate life through dozens of death crises on a ruined planet. 

Eventually, I couldn't stand it anymore, and I was hit by a zombie horde.... when I opened my eyes again... I was back in the past just six months before the zombie virus came into the world! 

In the next six months, this peaceful world will perish.

세상이 멸망하기 6개월 전으로 회귀했다!
이것은 기회인가? 아니면 절망의 반복인가?!!

지구를 덮친 대재앙, 좀비 바이러스.
폐허가 된 지구에서 죽음의 위기를 수십 번 겪으며 지독하고 악착같이 살아남기를 3년.
나는 결국, 더는 버티지 못하고 좀비 떼에 덮혀 최후를 맞았다.

그리고… 다시 눈을 떴을 때…

앞으로 6개월 후, 이 평화로운 세상은 멸망한다!
그리고 오직 나만이 종말이 오는 것을 알고 있다!

멸망한 세상에서 살아남기 급급하던 나에게 다시 주어진 기회!
6개월의 시간은 희망인가, 절망인가!

다시 한번 멸망을 맞이한다면 미래를 바꿀 수 있을까?

description.ru:
Вернуться за шесть месяцев до того, как мир был разрушен?! Быть может это возможность? Или вновь повторяющееся отчаяние? Великая Чума, поразившая землю – зомби-апокалипсис. Три года я упорствовал, чтобы пережить десятки смертельных ситуаций на опустошенной земле. В итоге, я был загнан в угол и, оказавшись в ловушке среди зомби, погиб. И ... когда я снова открыл глаза ... я вернулся в тот месяц до того, как вирус зомби вспыхнул в мире! В ближайшие шесть месяцев этот мирный мир будет разрушен. И только я знаю, что конец уже близко! Это шанс, который был подарен мне, чтобы снова выжить в разрушенном мире?! Шесть месяцев - это надежда или отчаяние? Смогу ли я изменить будущее, если снова окажусь на грани исчезновения ?!

โยฮันจึงได้ออกเดินทางเพื่อรวบรวมผู้รอดชีวิตที่เหลืออยู่ให้มาต่อกรกับพวกคนชั่วที่จะโผล่มาในอนาคต
description.zh: 约翰在末日爆发后为了生存已奋战了三年之久，可还是难逃被队友连累，丧尸围攻致死。本以为一切都将结束的约翰再次醒来，却发现自己重生并回到了末日开始之前。一样的末日，一样得剧本。这一次他能集结自己的精英小队，在末日中杀出一条血路，再造末日新秩序吗？
description.zh-hk:
我回到了世界滅亡的六個月前?
這是機會?還是絕望的重演?

毀滅地球的災難——喪屍末日來臨，
我在成為廢墟的地球上歷經數十次死亡威脅，
艱辛又頑強地活過了三年。
最後，我再也撐不下去，
淹沒在喪屍群中，迎來了死亡。

然而...當我再次睜開眼...
卻發現自己回到了喪屍病毒席捲全世界的六個月之前!

六個月後，眼前這片和平的世界就會滅亡，
卻只有我知道末日即將來臨!!
在毀滅的世界中，為了生存而汲汲營營，
這是給我的第二次機會嗎?!
六個月的時間是希望，還是絕望?
若災難再次降臨，我能夠改變未來嗎?!
在世界末日起身對抗猖獗喪屍的生存動作漫畫
就此展開!

description.de: Nachdem Paz, die Stadt der Magier, zerstört wird, wird die Magierin Amina bei ihrem Versuch, in die Vergangenheit zu reisen, in einer magischen Lampe gefangen. Dreihundert Jahre später wird sie von Zakar, dem Kommandanten der Armee von Paz, geweckt. Amina möchte eigentlich schleunigst Zakars Wünsche in Erfüllung bringen und in die Lampe zurückkehren, weil ihr diese neue Welt viel zu fremd ist. Während sie sich an die neue Welt gewöhnt, nehmen die Verschwörungen und Gefahren, die die beiden umgeben, kein Ende. Wird es Amina letztendlich gelingen, ihren eigenen Wunsch wahr werden zu lassen?
description.en:
On the day of the Wizarding City Paz's destruction, Amina got stuck inside a lamp while trying to turn back time. And 300 years later, she was awakened by a military commander, Jakal.

“I do not have any wishes for you to grant.”
Well, I just want to hurry and grant a wish so I can go back, who the hell is this guy?
  
“Do you know who I am?”
“There is no one else in this world who knows you better than I do.”
“That’s not possible… I’ll disappear one of these days!”

Amina, who needs to go back into the lamp after granted the wishes suddenly meets Jakal who wants to give up his wishes to be with her. However, there are many dangers and threats that prevent him from doing so. Will Amina achieve her wish in the end?

---
What can you do with three wishes?
Amina, one of the last wizards, loses her loved ones when her palace comes under attack. Trying to turn back time to save them, she gets stuck inside a lamp. 300 years later, Jakard, a military commander, wakes her up. He has three wishes before Amina returns to the lamp. What will he wish for?
description.es:
¿Qué puedes hacer con tres deseos?
Amina, la última hechicera, pierde a todos sus seres queridos en el ataque a su palacio. Intenta volver en el tiempo para salvarlos, pero queda atrapada dentro de una lámpara. El comandante Jakard la despierta 300 años más tarde. Tiene tres deseos antes de que ella regrese a la lámpara. ¿Qué pedirá?
description.id: Amina adalah garis keturunan terakhir penyihir di kota Paz. Suatu hari, dia menyaksikan istananya diserang masyarakat dan semua orang yang dikasihinya meninggal. Berkat bantuan rekannya, Amina berhasil menyelamatkan diri dari serangan tersebut. Amina menyesali peristiwa peristiwa itu harus terjadi. Dia pun merekomendasikan kembali ke masa lalu dengan menggunakan kekuatan sihirnya. Namun, usahanya tersebut gagal dan dia malah terperangkap di dalam lampu. Ketika dia berhasil keluar dari lampu, ternyata sudah 380 tahun berlalu! Seorang pria terluka di hadapannya telah mengeluarkan Amina dari lampu. Karena itu, Amina memberi 3 kesempatan bagi pria itu untuk permohonan permohonannya. Berhasilkah Amina mewujudkan permohonan tersebut? Siapa pria itu sebenarnya?
description.ko:
마법사의 도시 파즈가 쿠테타로 인해 멸망하는 날,
시간을 되돌리려고 하다가 램프에 갇혀버린 최후의 마법사 아미나.
그렇게 300여년이 흘러 파즈 군사령관 자카르에 의해 깨어난다.

소원을 다 들어주면 램프로 돌아가야만 하는 그녀와 소원을 
포기하고 함께 하고자 하는 자카르. 
하지만 그들을 둘러싼 암투와 위협은 끊이지 않는데... 

요정과 인간 사이 정체성을 사이에 둔 아미나의  성장 이야기가 
지금 시작된다!
description.pl:
Co możesz zrobić z trzema życzeniami?

Amina, jedna z ostatnich magików, utraciła wszystkich, których kochała podczas ataku na pałac. Próbując cofnąć się w czasie, aby ich ocalić, utknęła w lampie.

300 lat później pułkownik Jakal obudził ją.

Ma tylko trzy życzenia nim Amina wróci do lampy.

Czego sobie zażyczy?
description.ru:
В день разрушения волшебного города Паз Амина застряла внутри лампы, пытаясь повернуть время вспять. А 300 лет спустя её пробудил военачальник Шакал.

— У меня нет никаких желаний, которые ты могла бы выполнить. — Сказал он.

«Блин, я просто хочу поскорее исполнить желание, чтобы вернуться обратно. Кто, чёрт возьми, этот парень?»

— Но так нельзя! Я же просто исчезну в один прекрасный день!

 Амина, которой нужно непременно вернуться в лампу после исполнения желаний, внезапно встретила Шакала, который хочет отказаться от своих желаний и быть с ней. Но есть немало опасностей и угроз, которые мешают ему сделать это. Добьётся ли Амина в конце концов своего желания?

description.en:
[Will you join the game?]

Giyoung's suddenly thrown into a game of life and death. Not only that, but he's also the player with the lowest stats. Still, he's got one skill on his side: the ability to read other players' status!

He finds the opportunity of his life when he discovers that Hyunsung is a returner to this world.

Now all Giyoung has to do is stick next to Hyunsung and game his way out of this tutorial.
description.fr:
Un jour, j’ai été convoqué dans ce monde.
Les bêtes se sont déversées, et une crise incroyable est survenue.
Mes talents n’auraient pas pu être pires.
[Le niveau de talent du joueur est au plus bas.] [Presque tous les chiffres sont sans espoir.]
Que vous deviez devenir un guerrier ou un sorcier.
Que vous ayez remonté le temps.
Vous devez tirer parti de tout pour survivre.
« Et alors ? »
« Je vais utiliser tout ce que j’ai pour survivre ! »
description.ko:
어느 날, 이 세계에 소환된 이기영.
정체를 알 수 없는 공간에 사람들과 함께 감금당했다. 
우왕좌왕한 순간 들려오는 섬찟한 경고. 
"살아남기 위해서, 당신의 재능과 특성을 이용하십시오."

재능? 특성?
자신의 재능 창을 열어 능력을 확인하는데…
[플레이어의 재능 수치는 최하입니다.]

살아남을 수 없는 절망의 순간.
그에게 주어진 단 하나의 특성.

이거다. 

타인의 재능과 상태 창을 볼 수 있는 특성.
살아남기 위해 능력 있는 인간들에게 빌붙자.

그렇게 찾아낸 보물.
회귀자, 김현성.

이번 생이 2회차, 세계의 끝을 본 최강자. 
우리 끝까지 함께 하는 거다.
푸헤헿

description.pt-br:
“Estou disposto a usar todo mundo pra viver numa boa!”

Quando Lee Kiyoung se vê teletransportado para outro mundo, o desespero começa a se acumular. Várias pessoas desconhecidas em um lugar ainda mais misterioso. E então, a voz assustadora surge e fala que, para sobreviver, eles terão que usar suas habilidades e atributos. Mesmo tendo os piores atributos já vistos, Kiyoung descobre sua nova habilidade, o "Olho da Mente", que te permite acessar as janelas de status de todos os outros. Ao sair da zona inicial, Kiyoung encontra Kim Hyunsung, mas espera aí... O que é isso? Ele é um regressor? É aí que Kiyoung vê sua oportunidade de explorar esse mundo vivendo numa boa!

Zephyr kämpft als letzter Überlebender der Menschheit gegen das Böse in einer von den Göttern verlassenen Welt. Als er in einer Schlacht von Tartarus, dem Gott der Zerstörung, getötet wird, scheint alle Hoffnung für die Menschheit verloren. Doch Zephyrs Schicksal ist nicht besiegelt. Die Götter, für die seine Kämpfe als Unterhaltung dienen, geben ihm eine zweite Chance und schicken ihn zehn Jahre in die Vergangenheit, als er noch ein Sklave war und nicht der mächtigste Mensch der Welt. Kann Zephyr sich an Tartarus rächen und die Frau retten, die er liebt, oder ist er dazu verdammt, die Vergangenheit zu wiederholen?

Zephyr is the last human fighting evil in a world abandoned by the gods. When he is killed in battle by Tartarus, the god of destruction, all hope for humanity seems lost.

But Zephyr's fate is not sealed - the gods who find his battles entertaining have gifted him a second chance at life, as he is sent ten years into the past, back to when he was a slave instead of the most powerful human alive.

Can Zephyr get his revenge against Tartarus and save the woman he loves, or is he doomed to repeat the past?

Céfiro es el último humano capaz de enfrentarse al mal en un mundo abandonado por los dioses. Tras caer en batalla a manos de Tártaro, el dios de la destrucción, la esperanza de la humanidad se esfuma rápidamente. Sin embargo, el destino de Céfiro no está grabado a fuego; los dioses que se entretuvieron observando sus batallas le han dado la posibilidad de volver a vivir su vida y lo han enviado diez años al pasado, a la época en la que Céfiro era un esclavo y no el humano más poderoso de todos. ¿Podrá Céfiro vengarse de Tártaro y salvar a la mujer que ama? ¿O estará condenado a repetir el pasado?

title.en: I Was the Male Lead's Ex

altTitles.en: I Am the Male Lead’s Ex-Girlfriend

description.en:
The original Erica was written as the pitiful ex of the novel’s male lead, Reo. Now that I’m her, I refuse that pathetic side role, and I’ll cast him aside first! But then again… the way he looks at me, with those gentle eyes… 

No! I must stay strong. All the male leads fall for Juliana anyway. I can’t compete with her (she’s the protagonist!), but it feels like these men are throwing me into the ring! Should I let the plot run its course or save a few broken hearts and give my destiny a rewrite?
description.fr:
Érica a une particularité : elle se souvient de sa vie d'avant. Elle a donc conscience d'être dans un roman et de vivre dans la peau de la diabolique ex-petite amie du héros, Léo. 

Cherchant à échapper à son triste destin de méchante, elle décide de le quitter froidement. Mais un jour, Léo refait subitement surface dans sa vie et déclare qu'il veut la reconquérir. 

Saura-t-elle lui résister ? Et que faire du beau Zionne, meilleur ami de Léo, dont le comportement à son égard est plus qu'étrange ?

After being poisoned by the woman responsible for her mother’s death, Princess Marianne vows revenge! Дочь короля демонов Юрисина по достижении совершеннолетия заключила контракт с человеком, взяв в залог его душу. Она мечтала о признании от великих демонов. Однако у этого человека не было желания. Но в однажды он вселил Юрисину в тело принцессы, находившейся на краю гибели. Это была первая принцесса королевства Пейдин Мариэн. description.de: Edith Rigelhof ist eine charismatische Schurkin. Das glauben zumindest alle, doch eigentlich wird sie von ihrer eigenen Familie misshandelt. Auch Soona glaubte dies, bevor sie in der Rolle der Edith aus ihrem Lieblingsroman aufwacht. Und auch Killian, ihr zukünftiger Ehemann und der zweite Sohn der Herzogsfamilie Rudwick, die mit den Rigelhofs verfeindet sind, glaubt dies. Killian, der im ursprünglichen Roman Edith tötet, ist nicht gerade begeistert von der arrangierten Ehe mit Edith und macht keinen Hehl aus seiner Abneigung. Kann sie es inmitten der Intrigen schaffen, ihr unglückliches Ende zu vermeiden und Killians Herz doch noch zu gewinnen?
description.en: Not all villains are evil. When Suna Choi reincarnates as Edith Rigelhof, the villain from her favorite novel, she is determined to change Edith’s life around and treats everyone with kindness. Although she marries the handsome Killian Rudwick, he is madly in love with the original protagonist of the book and mistrusts Edith because she is from a rival family. Will her marriage survive the whirlwind of family feuds, love triangles, and more? Will Edith find her happy ending?
description.es: No todos los villanos son malvados. Cuando Suna Choi se reencarna en Edith Rigelhof, la villana de su novela favorita, está decidida a cambiar la vida de Edith y trata a todos con amabilidad. Aunque se casa con el apuesto Killian Rudwick, él está locamente enamorado de la protagonista original del libro y desconfía de Edith debido a que es de una familia rival. ¿Sobrevivirá su matrimonio al torbellino de disputas familiares, triángulos amorosos y más? ¿Encontrará Edith su final feliz?
description.fr: Ce n’était donc pas suffisant pour Soona de se faire poignarder dans le dos par ses collègues et son petit-ami. Son petit frère, accro aux jeux d’argent, vient de la tuer de ses propres mains ! Mais quel n'est pas son étonnement quand elle découvre, juste après cette mort tragique, qu'elle s'est réincarnée en personnage secondaire d'une histoire romantique fantastique lue quelque temps avant. Même si Edith, la méchante dans laquelle elle est réincarnée, n'a pas la vie facile... elle a bien l'intention de profiter de cette opportunité au maximum. Le séduisant mari de l'héroïne, Lizzie, est au cœur de ses motivations. D'ailleurs, elle a l'impression que l’histoire originale commence déjà à changer...
description.hu: Nem minden gonosztevő gonosz. Amikor Suna Choi Edith Rigelhofként, kedvenc regényének gonosztevőjeként reinkarnálódik, elhatározza, hogy megváltoztatja Edith életét, és mindenkivel kedvesen bánik. Bár feleségül megy a jóképű Killian Rudwickhoz, a férfi őrülten szerelmes a könyv eredeti főszereplőjébe, és bizalmatlan Edithtel szemben, mert az rivális családból származik. Vajon túléli-e a házassága a családi viszályok, szerelmi háromszögek örvényét? Vajon Edith megtalálja a boldog befejezést?
description.id: Setelah kecelakaan yang dialaminya, seorang perempuan malang bereinkarnasi menjadi Edith Rigelfhof, peran antagonis dari webnovel “Tanpa Obsesi” yang ia baca semalaman! Sebagai penggemar berat cerita romantis-fantasi, dia tahu akhir mengerikan yang akan dialami karakter Edith dan bertekad untuk menghindari nasibnya pada cerita asli! Dimulai dari pernikahan politik dengan putra dari Count Rudwick yang sangat tampan, bisakah Edith menikmati hidup barunya sebagai bangsawan dan menghindari ajal yang sudah menjadi takdirnya?
description.ko:
그럼 그렇지, 내 팔자에 무슨 주인공이야.

남편 손에 죽을 팔자의 악녀였지만, 난 이 클리셰를 안다!​
억울하게 죽은 대가로는 꽤 괜찮다고 생각했다.
원작의 흐름에서 벗어나지 못한다는 걸 깨닫기 전까지는.
결국 원작대로 죽을 거라면, 될 대로 되라지.

“아니, 저는 그냥 뽀뽀만…….”
“뭐, 좋습니다.”
“예……? 뭐, 뭐가요?”

내 팔뚝을 잡은 손에 힘을 전혀 빼지 않은 채로, 그가 몸을 완전히 일으켰다.

그래, 이렇게 해서 나를 문밖으로 질질 끌고 나가……야 하는데 왜 날 침대로 던지니?

......왜 원작이 달라지기 시작하는 거지?
description.pl: Nie wszyscy złoczyńcy są źli. Kiedy Suna Choi reinkarnuje się jako Edith Rigelhof, czarny charakter z jej ulubionej powieści, jest zdeterminowana, aby zmienić życie Edith i traktuje wszystkich z życzliwością. Chociaż poślubia przystojnego Killiana Rudwicka, jest on szaleńczo zakochany w oryginalnej bohaterce książki i nie ufa Edith, ponieważ pochodzi ona z konkurencyjnej rodziny. Czy jej małżeństwo przetrwa wir rodzinnych waśni, miłosnych trójkątów i nie tylko? Czy Edith znajdzie swoje szczęśliwe zakończenie?
description.ru: Что ж, верно, разве могу я быть главной героиней? Я стала злодейкой, которая умрёт от рук своего мужа, ну что за клише! Мне не хотелось заканчивать всё несправедливой смертью. Но так было до тех пор, пока я не поняла, что могу выбраться из течения оригинальной истории. Если в итоге я всё равно умру, почему бы не попробовать поцеловать своего красавчика мужа? "Что ж, цветочная змея Ригельхоф, попробуй удовлетворить меня. Кто знает, может хотя бы твое тело будет полезным." Почему оригинальная история начала меняться?
description.th: “นางร้ายที่ต้องตายด้วยน้ำมือสามีตัวเอง” พล็อตแบบนี้ฉันเคยอ่านเจอมาแล้ว ถ้าเปลี่ยนแปลงเรื่องราวของต้นฉบับไม่ได้ อย่างน้อยขอจูบสามีสุดหล่อสักหน่อยเถอะ! แต่ทำไม...ฉันรู้สึกว่าเรื่องราวมันเริ่มเปลี่ยนไปจากต้นฉบับแล้วเนี่ย
description.zh:
穿越小说成了反派女配，
为了不领盒饭狂撩男主？
哼，我就知道…我这命数怎么可能会是主人公呢。虽然穿越成了一个注定会死在丈夫手里的恶女，但这个套路我熟悉啊!不就是穿书嘛，只要不作死，一切都会变得灰常~美好~（星星眼）等等！怎么剧情无法被我改变呢？难道我注定只能“嘎”在这个小说世界里了嘛？既然如此…作为一个注定会下线的小小NPC，只能是被迫走主线剧情听从命运的安排啦~嘿嘿嘿我的老公~快来跟我抱抱亲亲举高高呀~~
description.zh-hk: 是啊⋯⋯我命這麼苦，怎麼可能當主角⋯⋯ 意外死亡後，我重生為我死前讀過的小說中的惡女。雖然在小說中，這惡女最後會死在自己丈夫手上，但我知道這故事會怎麼發展，我可以阻止不幸的發生！ 作為前世冤死的代價，我覺得重生成為惡女也是挺不錯的～ 不過這種想法僅維持了一下子，因為後來我理解到我無法改變原本的劇情發展⋯⋯ 如果最終我還是會如同原作劇情一樣死去的話，那至少也得讓我親一下我的美男老公吧！ 「像狐狸精一樣滿足我看看吧，誰知道呢？說不定我們會藉由身體產生出感情。」 咦…為什麼劇情突然開始變得不一樣了？

description.en:
Seongwu is a former special forces soldier who has returned to college after completing his national service. His ordinary life as a student is shattered during class one day when he and his fellow students are faced with a mysterious prompt asking them to “select a role.”

Seongwu chooses the necromancer, a rare ability that grants him the power to control the undead.

With the campus and outside world seemingly on the brink of collapse, Seongwu must use his newfound powers to battle fearsome monsters and help save his fellow students. But will they make it out alive?

Celle choisie déterminera leurs pouvoirs qui leur permettront de survivre dans un monde chaotique, qui ressemble fortement à un jeu vidéo. Pour sa part, Seong-woo sera un nécromancien !

description.es: Cambiare el destino del villano Azeg, incluso si es necesario sacrificarlo todo...¿podrá ella descubrir los secretos escondidos que Azeg oculta para poder salvarlo?
description.fr: Lady Elzay est prête à risquer sa vie pour changer le destin tragique du marquis Azeph Randel qui n'est autre que le méchant de l'histoire. Elzay parviendra-t-elle à agir contre le sceau de dieu qui lui est gravé pour libérer Azeph de son malheur?
description.it: Legato alla tragedia e alla sventura fin dalla tenera età, Aseph Randell è destinato a morire come cattivo della sua stessa storia... Almeno fino a quando la misteriosa Elzay Tiathe appare nella sua vita con una promessa: "Posso salvarti". Dopo aver avuto visioni vivide di lui per moltissimo tempo e conoscere la sua storia come nemmeno lui la conosce, Elzay può districare il destino contorto legato ad Aseph ... o saranno entrambi trascinati verso un destino crudele?
description.ru: Одна женщина поклялась изменить судьбу злодея Азефа, даже если ей придется растоптать всё на своем пути. Сможет ли она спасти его, сохранив при этом свой магический герб?
description.th: เอลเซย์ ผู้หญิงคนที่มีความตั้งใจจะเปลี่ยนโชคชะตาของตัวร้ายอาเซฟแม้จะต้องสูญเสียทุกอย่าง เธอจะช่วยชีวิตของเขาไว้ได้หรือไม่
description.vi:
Từ một đứa trẻ được cha mẹ yêu thương, cho đến khi gia đình tan vỡ, lưu lạc thành trẻ mồ côi, luôn cúi đầu thấp hèn chỉ cầu được sống. Nam phụ - Ajeff, trong câu chuyện đó không giành được trái tim của nữ chính, cuối cùng hóa thành quỷ dữ và chết dưới lưỡi kiếm của kẻ khác.
Elza Thiase xuyên không vào trong cuốn tiểu thuyết đó, không vì nam nữ chính, mà vì Ajeff. Liệu tình cảm của cô giành cho anh chỉ có thương hại hay còn gì khác nữa?
description.zh: 她因小说里男主雅瑟夫的悲惨命运伤心流泪，某天醒来时发现自己已然穿越进了小说世界，还成为了小说女主的双胞胎姐姐——艾尔莎。但她苦恼着该如何帮助男主雅瑟夫摆脱命运的摧残。然而面对雅瑟夫一次又一次的欺骗，她会做出怎样的抉择，又是否能成功救赎男主呢？
description.zh-hk: 深陷小說情節，為亞緹夫的悲慘遭遇感到心痛的她，因緣際會下，竟進入書中世界成為艾潔依。她賭上自己的一切，試圖改變墮落的亞緹夫的命運，不僅隱瞞了自己已經擁有命定戀人的事實，更竭盡所能阻止亞緹夫與他的愛人艾莉莎相遇，究竟艾潔依所做的一切，是否能如她所願拯救可憐的亞緹夫呢?

description.en:
Blessed with the face of an angel, young Sasha Tartt knows a life-altering secret: in this romance novel where she’s just a side character, she’s the only one who knows the true ending! When the antagonist of the story takes a particular liking to her, she must make a decision: help the clever and beautiful Rebecca find a happy ending, or side with the sweet-natured protagonist to ensure her own survival? On top of that, Sasha has to juggle the affections of her bespectacled love interest and tame a dragon boy! Can Sasha learn new tricks to win the hearts of these main characters?

---
"My dear villainess, do whatever you want to do. Just don't see that son of a bitch." 

A girl dies and is reincarnated as Sasha, the daughter of a poor noble family in a romance novel she used to read. To survive in her new life, she approaches noble ladies with her innocent appearance and cold wit. Hence, she got the nickname 'the Nobles' Pet.'

Rebecca, the villainess of the original work and the Prince's fiancée, appears in front of Sasha, who's using her talent to live the sweet life. Knowing the end of the original, Sasha tried to stay away from Rebecca, but she cannot take her eyes off her cool and collectedness! So Sasha uses her cuteness as a deadly weapon to stand between Rebecca and the womanizer Crown Prince… and… can Sasha survive and win Rebecca's favor?

The villainess Rebecca X Healing Pet Sasha's fantasy!

"우리 악녀님 하고 싶은 일 다 해.
단, 그 새끼만 만나지 마."

별 볼 일 없는 가문의 딸인 샤샤는 빙의 후
그나마 믿을 만한 얼굴을 무기로 영애들에게 접근한다.
그래서 얻게 된 별명이 ‘높으신 분들의 애완동물’.
자신의 특기를 살려 여주인공 곁에서 꿀 빨며 살려던
샤샤의 앞에 원작의 악녀이자 황태자의 약혼녀 레베카가 나타난다.

원작의 결말을 알고 있는 샤샤는 레베카를 멀리하려 하지만
어쩐지 쿨하고 멋진 그녀에게서 눈을 뗄 수가 없다!
파멸이 예정된 레베카를 두고 볼 수 없게 된 샤샤.

샤샤는 치명적인 귀여움을 무기로
레베카와 바람둥이 황태자 사이를 멀어지게 하는데…….

샤샤는 레베카의 옆에서 호의호식하며 살 수 있을까?!

"Minha querida vilã, faça o que quiser. Só não veja aquele filho da puta."

Uma menina morre e é reencarnada como Sasha, filha de uma família pobre e nobre em um romance que costumava ler. Para sobreviver em sua nova vida, ela aborda nobres damas com sua aparência inocente e humor frio.

Por isso, ela recebeu o apelido de "O animal de estimação do nobre."

Rebecca, a vilã do trabalho original e a noiva do príncipe, aparece na frente de Sasha, que está usando seu talento para viver a vida doce. Sabendo o final do original, Sasha tentou ficar longe de Rebecca, mas ela não consegue tirar os olhos de sua calma e coletividade! Então Sasha usa sua fofura como uma arma mortal para ficar entre Rebecca e o príncipe herdeiro mulherengo e... Sasha pode sobreviver e ganhar o favor de Rebecca?

Саша, дочь бедной дворянской семьи, сблизилась с благородными дамами благодаря её невинной внешности и холодному расчёту. On the outside, Ailette Rodeline is an adorable child prodigy. Cooking, brewing tea, alchemy; you name it, she can do it. But this little girl has a big secret: Ailette is a transmigrator! 

After dying prematurely in her past life, she becomes a character whose world is destined for destruction. With all odds stacked against her, Ailette must figure out how to survive before her life is ripped from her again. 

Fortunately for her, she finds her salvation in… an insurance package?

description.zh-hk:
應對死後世界!死前收到的奇怪的垃圾短信。以為死了，睜開眼以後發現身處附身審查局。

真的有死後世界?被附身在書裡?“你有什麼特別喜歡的類型嗎?” 前世因追星涉獵了所有題材的我。

雖然希望下輩子能成為養成系的可愛小女孩，獨占無限愛。但我要附的書是-生存難易度S級，充滿地瓜的無限復活系<直到拯救世界為止的複活>。

在那裡被附身的角色是-在對主人公作威作福的流氓貴族家-被人欺負的平民僕人的女兒?!

但是因為在臨死之前加入了<附身生命保險套餐>得到了特級特惠…從追星中獲得的直覺和保險特惠，神的偏愛寵愛在充滿地瓜的S級生存的故事!

biography.en: A webnovelist.

description.en:
I died in an accident while I was chased by debt collectors. Then I transmigrated into the book *The Fairy's Garden*, but why did I have to possess the villainess?!

Aine le Peregrine, an infamous *femme fatale*, was the villainess. Besides harassing the heroine, she also has a peculiar hobby of collecting beautiful men. But in the end, she died at the hands of the men she collected…

No, I can't die like this! Alright! Starting today, my goal is to say farewell.

---
I need to safely break up with these men immediately!

"The reason I came to the duchy today is not to break off the engagement, but to tell you I have no intention of breaking off the engagement."

…Why is this man acting like this? The Grand Duke who should be falling in love with the heroine does not want to break off our engagement. Not only him, but the unfathomable Assassin King J and the wolf-man that brings out my motherly instinct, Shion… The more I try to get rid of them, the harder they stick onto me. Will I be able to safely break up with these three men and preserve my life?!

---
Ayne le Poregrin has three "trophies" in her collection of men: a reluctant fiancé held hostage by his debts, a fickle assassin paid to be her lover, and a soulless pet dog won at a slave auction. But to suddenly wake up one day as this femme fatale is the worst possible surprise. As the villainess of the novel *The Fairy Garden*, the new "Ayne" is fated to die a painful death at the hands of her very own trophies! To sidestep her grim future, she knows she'll need to break up with all three. As soon as she tries to say goodbye, however, each man becomes attached and won't leave her alone! Can Ayne turn their affections towards the story's heroine and save her own life in the process? Based on the hit novel.

description.fr:
Qui aurait cru qu'un jour je me réveillerais dans l'univers de ce roman que j'aime tant? Vivre une vie pauvre et tragique, mourir de la même manière... puis me réveiller dans le corps d'Ayne le Poregrin, la sublime et riche femme fatale du livre *Le Jardin enchanté*, c'est donc cela mon destin? Mais je ne compte pas mener la même vie qu'Ayne! Après tout, elle finit par mourir, elle aussi, et je veux profiter de cette nouvelle chance pour avoir une belle vie. Il va falloir que je coupe les ponts avec tous les hommes de sa collection afin de me protéger, mais je sens que cette tâche ne sera pas une mince affaire...

Four tyrants. Which one of them is my father?!  
After working herself to death, professor Jaehee Cheon is reincarnated as a princess in a fantasy novel. Now, she must find her father from the four candidates before her, or face death — again. Will Jaehee get her happy ending?

description.ru:
Доктор Чхон Джэхи потеряла родителей в раннем возрасте и не может вспомнить их лица, прожила жизнь без друзей, не говоря уже о любовнике, а теперь переродилась в несчастную принцессу в мире романа, которая умрёт в возрасте двенадцати лет!  
Если не найти биологического отца принцессы, она непременно умрет. Но тут есть целых четыре кандидата?! И куда большая проблема в том, что они слишком опасны…

Sanghyeon Kim has the talent and the drive to become a K-pop star—but one thing keeps holding him back: a false school bullying accusation.
After countless rejections, his dream feels more distant than ever.

But when the head director of a major entertainment company hands him a mysterious bath bomb that transforms him into his past-life self, he's suddenly staring at an unbelievably beautiful... woman?

Sanghyeon's second shot at fame is about to begin—in the most unexpected way!

description.ko:
학폭 가해자라는 치명적인 누명을 쓰고 아이돌을 꿈꾸는 김상현.
어느 날 찾아온 대형 기획사 실장의 제안으로 '전생의 모습으로 바꿔주는 약'을 사용하게 되는데, 
변신한 거울 속 전생의 모습은 엄청난 미인.. 그런데 여자?
과연 남자라는 정체를 들키지 않고 연습생들 무리에서 살아남을 수 있을까?
description.th: คิมซังฮยอน เด็กหนุ่มที่ใฝ่ฝันอยากเป็นไอดอล กลับถูกใส่ร้ายจนเป็นตราบาปติดตัวว่าเขาเคยเป็น "อดีตนักเลงในโรงเรียน" แต่แล้ววันหนึ่ง เขาได้รับข้อเสนอจากผู้บริหารค่ายบันเทิงยักษ์ใหญ่ พร้อมกับ "ยา" ที่จะเปลี่ยนเขาให้กลับไปเป็นรูปลักษณ์ในชาติก่อน แต่เมื่อเขามองเข้าไปในกระจกเขากลับเห็น "หญิงสาวแสนสวย" ที่งดงามเกินจะบรรยายได้! ขอเน้นย้ำอีกที… สาวงาม! ผู้หญิง!? ในโลกที่เต็มไปด้วยการแข่งขันและความลับ คิมซังฮยอนจะสามารถปกปิดตัวตนที่แท้จริง และเอาตัวรอดท่ามกลางเหล่าเด็กฝึกหัดได้หรือไม่?
description.vi: Kim Sang Hyun nuôi ước mơ trở thành thần tượng, nhưng quá khứ từng là kẻ bắt nạt học đường khiến cậu mang tiếng xấu.  Một ngày nọ, cậu bất ngờ nhận được lời đề nghị từ một giám đốc cấp cao của công ty giải trí hàng đầu. Sau khi uống một viên thuốc bí ẩn, Sang Hyun bỗng hóa thành diện mạo của chính mình trong kiếp trước. Nhưng điều gây sốc hơn cả - hình ảnh phản chiếu trong gương lại là… một cô gái xinh đẹp?!  Giờ đây, cậu phải sinh tồn giữa những thực tập sinh khác mà không để lộ thân phận thật sự là một chàng trai! Liệu bí mật này có thể được giữ kín cho đến cuối cùng?
description.zh:
男主伪装女练习生，出道路惊险又高能！
梦想成为偶像的“他”，被冤枉成校园霸凌者后人生跌落谷底。某天，他服下神秘药丸，变身为“前世的自己”——竟是惊艳四座的美女？！在女练习生堆中，他能隐藏身份成功出道吗？
description.zh-hk: 金上泫一心夢想成為偶像，卻背上「校園暴力加害者」這要命的黑鍋。 某天，他接受了大型經紀公司企劃室長的提議，用了「變身成前世模樣的藥」，沒想到鏡中前世的他竟是個絕世美人…可是，變成女生欸？ 究竟他能不能隱藏自己男性的真實身分，從眾多競爭激烈的練習生中脫穎而出呢？

description.en: Qi, swords, martial artists… and robots and spaceships?! The year is 3077, thousands of years after the heyday of the martial arts realm. Humanity inhabits the stars, governed by interstellar martial arts organizations who kept the old ways of the realm alive: might makes right! For bounty hunters like Seryeong, Robert, and Sunja, this means trouble is good for business, except when they bite off more than they can chew. After venturing to the irradiated wasteland of Earth for a top bounty, only to find a 2,000-year-old martial artist instead, they realize their fortunes are about to change…

description.en:
As a child, Elijah became a count's famous footman, a master of his work… But "his" work is secretly more like "her" work, as Elijah is in fact a woman. So, every day, she wakes up at 6 AM, conceals her chest with bandages, and carries on her duty. And she will continue to do until, "On my 18th birthday, I will quit my life as a footman and live as a woman!"   
  
Yet, a sudden proposal comes: "Elijah, you should dress up for the ball and become my partner." A perfect dress, never-before-seen makeup… and the gentle Count Albert as her escort.   
  
How will destiny unfold for Elijah?

The Hero has defeated the Demon King! But the Princess he meant to save turned out to be a Prince. NEETdom, here he comes, but a life of relaxation surrounded by animes is a pretty sweet deal.  
  
Unfortunately, he gets caught up in millennia old legends, curses, and a twisted plot involving multiple Kingdoms and many dragons. Through and through, though, he'll follow a path of whimsy, even if that involves him palling it up with "villains".

description.en:
In the game Aether World, **Baek Yuseol** is considered the most useless character because he can't use magic like everyone else. His only skill, Blink, is a short-range teleportation ability most players consider worthless. But when he’s tasked with reaching the game's true ending, Baek Yuseol decides to use his unconventional skill to achieve this impossible goal. 

Can this so-called "**TRASH**" character outsmart his powerful peers, form unlikely alliances, and ultimately master the game?
description.pt-br: O personagem com maior dificuldade e pior desempenho, Baek Yuseol, foi considerado um personagem lixo no jogo porque não conseguia usar magia em um cenário de fantasia onde todos os outros podiam. No entanto… [Como o final errado foi alcançado, 90% do Mundo Éter foi destruído.] [Por favor, alcance o “Final Verdadeiro”.] De repente, essas palavras ecoaram em minha mente antes de eu ser transmigrado para o Mundo Éter. [Você pode usar a habilidade “Teletransporte”.] “Por que eu possuí esse personagem?” Teletransporte era a única habilidade mágica que eu tinha. Sobrevivendo na Academia Stella entre magos geniais, me tornei o notório Mago do Teletransporte.

description.uk:
Такого героя ще не було!
Він герой, чи справжній демон?

Кан Хансу був призваний у цей світ разом зі своїми однокласниками.
Його однокласники були вражені цим абсолютно новим світом і магією в ньому, але єдине, чого хотів Хансу, — це швидко повернутися додому.

"Навіщо мені відмовлятися від свого теплого, затишного дому, щоб отримати пригоду в цьому світі…?

Навіть богиня, яка викликала мене, сказала, що якщо я не хочу, вона не буде змушувати мене, і пообіцяла повернути мене в мій початковий світ.
Вона телепортувала мене, але…

Коли я відкрив очі, я досі був у цьому світі!
Усі мої друзі зникли, а навколо мене були лише монстри!!

Якась богиня обдурила мене...?
Як мені тепер повернутися додому...?
Більше того, як мені тут вижити...?!"
description.pt-br:
“Quando virar herói pode ser uma benção ou maldição, você molda o seu próprio destino!”

Nunca existiu um herói como ele antes! Esse cara é um herói ou um demônio?

Kang Hansoo foi invocado em outro mundo com seus colegas de classe.
Seus colegas ficaram impressionados com esse novo mundo e com a magia que havia nele, mas a única coisa que Hansoo queria fazer era voltar logo para casa.

“Por que eu abandonaria a minha casa quentinha e confortável para ter uma aventura neste mundo…?”

Até a deusa que me invocou disse que se eu não estivesse disposto, não havia nada que ela pudesse fazer para me forçar e prometeu me devolver ao meu mundo original.
Ela me teletransportou, mas…

Quando abri os olhos, eu ainda estava neste mundo!
Todos os meus amigos se foram e a única coisa ao meu redor eram monstros!!

Uma deusa me enganou...?
Como faço para voltar para casa agora...?
Mais importante, como é que vou sobreviver aqui…?!

description.en:
In the aftermath of the desperate battle between Goomoonryong and the Martial Arts Alliance – Yi Shioon's ki-center was destroyed by his own master Goomoonryong, leaving him unable to practice martial arts…  
  
Even though Shioon is no longer a murim-in, more assailants continue to pursue him. Through his encounter with Goomoonryong, the bullied boy has grown in to a respectable man. However, Shioon must now learn to survive in this chilly world of Murim without his master…

description.en:
Upon dying, the author of "The Demon King is Dead" is given two choices: go to hell or be reborn in his novel and survive till the end.

The problem? He's reborn as Baalier Junior, a weak demon prince, after his realm was conquered! To make things worse, his attempt to escape somehow gets him enrolled as a student of the Royal Class in Gradias Temple, a prestigious human school.

In the midst of plotlines and political schemes, can this author keep his identity a secret and reach a happy ending?
description.ja: 自分が書いた小説のアンチコメントを読んで頭に血がのぼり死んでしまった。 そんなあっけない死に方をした俺の前になぜか死神(？)が現れ、「常習的な休載」「失敗を何度も繰り返した」という罪により、完結作の中から選んだ『魔王は死んだ』という自作の小説に転生することになったが… よりによって物語の序盤で死んでしまう魔王の息子に転生してしまった…!? ＜小説のエンディングまで生き残るために最善を尽くしてください＞

Grouchy, foul-mouthed Penelope is reluctant to let the emperor into her heart after her first engagement went so wrong. Can the emperor change her mind and win her heart?
description.pt-br:
Penelope, 24 anos.  
Uma linda filha de um barão por fora, uma velhinha maldosa por dentro!  
  
Mas o homem com quem ela passou a noite sob o efeito do álcool … era o imperador?  
  
"Droga, aquele homem está em todo lugar."  
"Vou me certificar de colocar minhas mãos nela."  
  
Experimente a fantasia de romance vibrante dos dois!

description.en:
With her fierce eyes and sharp impression, and wary of everyone, 'Ahn Se-young' is a woman to watch out for.
Everyone is cautious around her, but a lone boy stands in front of her.
"I like you, go out with me!"
"......What?!"
Se-young is taken aback at the sudden confession of love, but this was just the beginning...
The tug-of-war between 'Ahn Se-young', who shows an unexpected side to her as you get closer, and 'Nam Ho-yeol', the straightforward guy who tries to break down her impenetrable facade, begins now!
description.ko:
사나운 눈매와 날카로운 인상으로 주변 사람들에게 경계를 받고 있는 요주의 그녀 '안세영'.
모두가 경계심을 놓지 못할 때 그녀의 앞에 한 남자애가 마주선다.
"나 너 좋아해, 나랑 사귀자!"
"......뭐?!"
난데없는 사랑고백에 진땀이 빠지는 세영, 하지만 이건 시작에 불과했으니...
가까이 다가갈수록 반전의 모습을 보이는 그녀 '안세영'과
그 모습을 빈틈없이 파고 들려는 직진남 '남호열'의 줄다리기가 지금 시작된다!

altTitles.en: The Lazy Prince Becomes a Genius

description.en:
After witnessing the shocking death of his mother, young Airen Farreira uses sleep to escape his painful reality, earning him the nickname, “the lazy lord”. Yet, in spite of others’ jeers and whispers, Airen has no intention of changing his ways.

But when he awakens one day from a dream about a mysterious swordsman, his life’s trajectory takes a complete turn...

---
- [Alternative English Translation (Tappytoon)](https://www.tappytoon.com/en/comics/the-lazy-lord-masters-the-sword)
description.fr: Irene Perreira est un garçon qui dort pour s’enfuir de la réalité. Les gens se moquent de lui, en l’appelant 'bon à rien' , mais il n'a aucune envie de changer. Jusqu'à ce qu'un jour, il rêva d'un épéiste... C'était un rêve d'un homme sans talent qui a entraîné ses mouvements à l'épée pendant des décennies.
description.ja: 誰も期待していなかった一族の怠け者、アイルーンパレイラがついに剣を手に取る。
description.ko:
잠을 도피처로 삼아 온 소년 아이른 파레이라.
사람들은 그를 나태 공자라 부르며 조롱했지만 그는 변할 생각이 없었다.
어느 날 어느 검사의 꿈을 꾸기 전까지는...
그것은 그저 묵묵히 수십 년간 검을 휘두르며 단련하는 한 재능 없는 사내에 관한 꿈이었다.
description.ru:
Юный Айрон Парейра сделал свой мир грёз убежищем от боли трагедии прошлого. Людей забавляло это, они подняли его на смех и прозвали нерадивым аристократом. Однако подобное отношение никак не задевало нашего героя необходимостью меняться.
Так бы всё и продолжалось, не повстречай он во сне бездарного юношу, который тридцать семь лет подряд обучался владению мечом, да так и умер с оружием в руках.
description.pt-br: Irene Pareyra é um rapaz que dormia para fugir da realidade. As pessoas o zoavam, chamavam de preguiçoso, mas ele não tinha a intenção de mudar. Até que um dia ele sonhou com um espadachim… Foi um sonho sobre um homem sem talento que treinou por décadas brandindo sua espada.
description.zh-hk: 家族中的懶惰蟲終於拿起了劍！將睡覺視為逃避方法的少年艾倫．帕雷拉，即使人們都嘲笑他為懶惰公子，他依然不願改變，直到有天他夢見了一位數十年間不斷揮劍鍛練的無才男子...

An extreme survival story plays out after she dies and reincarnates as the daughter of Duke Langtry, who was cursed and killed. The frugal lady travels in search of her spaceship, which crash landed in the unfamiliar and barren fantasy world. A lively and brutal romance in court!

description.en:
Imprisoned for years, Princess Aristine hides her true nature and that she possesses the Emperor’s Eye—a skill to see past, present, and future that the emperor of Silvanus covets. Finally, her chance to escape comes when her father sends her to Ilugo, Silvanus’ enemy nation, as a scapegoat to incite war under the guise of an arranged marriage to Ilugo’s second prince, a known barbarian.

Now ready to take the reins to her life, will Aristine be able to make money to support her freedom?

---
I became the wife of a husband who has a girlfriend.
Hmm, I shouldn’t bother them, right?

“Then, you sleep on the floor.”
“What?”

It seems that he doesn’t like the idea of it.
Well, the floor is hard after all.
I guess I don’t have any other choice.

“We’ll just sleep while holding hands then. You trust me, right?”

But how did we end up breaking the bed on our first night…?

I am Aristine, an exiled princess who has fallen out of favor with the Emperor.
The truth is, she has the <Monarch’s Eyes>, an ability that allows you to see the past, future, and present.
Sacrificed for a contract marriage, she is bound together with a monstrous barbarian…

“I have to present my wife with the most precious things.”

The future husband who is rumored to be a monster is incredibly normal.

But this cake belongs to someone else.

“I’ll just go and make money.”

It’s long been said that imagining gold as your own will help you manifest wealth.

<Forget My Husband, I’ll Go Make Money>
Will she be able to achieve her dreams of living in freedom while sitting on her piles of money?
Or will she be able to catch both rabbits at the same time?
description.id: Aku, Aristine, adalah putri kaisar yang dipenjara. Sesungguhnya, aku memiliki "mata kaisar" yang bisa melihat masa depan, masa sekarang, dan masa lalu. Tapi, aku dijodohkan dengan seorang barbarian... Ternyata, calon suamiku yang katanya seperti monster itu biasa-biasa saja. Namun, semua harta yang ada di sini adalah milik orang lain. Sebaiknya aku cari uang saja supaya bisa hidup dengan bebas!
description.ko:
여친 있는 남자의 아내가 되어 버렸다.
음, 건드리지 말아야겠지?

“그럼 넌 바닥에서 자.”
“뭐?”

싫은 눈치다.
그래, 바닥은 딱딱하지.
그렇다면 어쩔 수 없다.

“손만 잡고 잘게. 누나 믿지?”

그런데 어쩌다 남편과 첫날밤에 침대를 부숴 버린 걸까…….

===

황제의 눈밖에 나 유폐당한 황녀, 아리스티네.
사실 그녀는 미래와 현재, 과거를 모두 볼 수  있는 <제왕안>의 소유자였다.
정략혼의 희생양이 된 그녀는 괴물 같은 야만인과 맺어지는데…….

“가장 귀한 것을 내 신부님께 드려야지.”

괴물이라던 예비 남편님이 지나치게 멀쩡하다.

하지만 이 떡은 남의 떡.

‘돈이나 벌어야지.’

자고로 황금 보기를 내 것같이 하라고 했다.


<남편은 됐고, 돈이나 벌겠습니다.>
과연 그녀는 돈방석에 앉아 자유롭게 사는 꿈을 이룰 수 있을까?
아니면 두 마리의 토끼를 동시에 잡게 될까?
description.ru: Оказалось, что у моего мужа есть другая женщина. Поэтому лучше уступить ей место, да? Стоп, тогда почему я нахожусь с ним в одной постели?.. Аристина – принцесса, которая всю жизнь провела в заточении по воле императора-отца. Внезапно пробудив «глаза императора», она обрела способность видеть прошлое, настоящее и будущее. Император отправляет Аристину на верную смерть в браке по расчёту с кровожадным принцем из соседней страны. Но... Тот самый женишок оказывается совершенно не таким, как о нём говорили. «Его сердце занято. Что ж... Значит, к чёрту мужа! Пришло время заработать много деньжат!» Сможет ли наша героиня стать богачкой, как того желает? Или ей удастся убить двух зайцев одним выстрелом и завоевать своего мужа?
description.uk: Батько мій, імператор, холодним голосом заявив про мої заручини в Айруґо, ворожим нашій імперії королівством, відверто сподіваючись на мою якнайшвидшу смерть, адже неодноразово вже докладав руку до замахів на моє життя. Моїм чоловіком мав стати жахливий варвар, чутки про якого не віщували щасливої долі. На додачу виявилося, що він уже мав кохану. Що ж, не в моїх інтересах руйнувати щире кохання, тож до біса чоловіка, у мене інші плани. Хочу жити щасливо і безтурботно, а для цього потрібні грошики. Отже, до роботи!

description.en: Born as the eldest daughter, she was raised and educated only to become Queen. Even though she had excellent fencing skills, she was not allowed to wield a sword. Nevertheless, she was happy. As Queen of the Kingdom of Mont, she was able to stay with her beloved King. But her happiness did not last long. The king betrayed her and condemned her. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself on the witch hunting ground outside the castle! People are calling her a witch and are trying to kill her. What is even going on?

description.en:
The sword of my closest friend and trusted adjutant pierced my body. When I opened my eyes again, I had become a noble lady of the enemy kingdom. In an unfamiliar and weak stranger’s body, three year’s time was lost, in which my homeland was brought to ruin. I was unable to come to my senses because of the pain of betrayal and confusion of my identity. However, eventually I decided to live on as 'Luciphella Aidine', a noble who wields a sword.  


---
description.es: La espada de mi amigo más cercano y ayudante de confianza atravesó mi cuerpo. Cuando volví a abrir los ojos, me había convertido en una noble dama del reino enemigo. En el cuerpo de un extraño desconocido y débil, se perdieron tres años en los que mi patria fue arruinada. No pude recuperar el sentido debido al dolor de la traición y la confusión de mi identidad. Sin embargo, finalmente decidí seguir viviendo como 'Luciphella Aidine', una noble que empuña una espada.
description.ru:
Рыцарь Эстель стала жертвой предательства и погибла ещё до финального сражения. От руки своего друга. Вот только попала она в свой личный ад. С войны на бал! В тело леди Люцифелии, невесты своего врага. Теперь её убийца постоянно находится рядом с ней. Полководец вражеской армии её жених, а она, смелый и благородный рыцарь, стала хрупкой леди, что и меча в руках не держала.  
Как выжить, не запутавшись в дворцовых интригах и светской жизни? Как затуманить разум своего врага, чтобы он ни о чём не догадался? И как тут найти любовь?
description.vi:
Thanh gươm của bạn thân và cũng là phụ tá đáng tin tưởng của tôi xuyên qua cơ thể của tôi.  
  
Khi mà tôi mở mắt ra, tôi đã trở thành một tiểu thư của một nhà quý tộc của phe địch của Vương quốc. Trong một cơ thể yếu đuối của một người lạ, ba năm đã trôi qua trong thời gian đó, đất mẹ của tôi đã bị hủy diệt. Tôi không thể hiểu được bất cứ chuyện gì vì nỗi đau của sự phản bội và sự hoang mang về danh tính của tôi.  
  
Thế nhưng, tôi đã quyết định sẽ sống như 'Luciphella Aidine', một quý tộc cầm một thanh kiếm.  


---

description.en:
There are animals that were abandoned by Dangun and live secretly in the human world. Narae, an ordinary high school student, discovers their existence...
A modern version of Beauty and the Beast with comedy and exorcism action.

‘Will the project of becoming human, for the animals that could not become human, be successful?'
description.pt-br:
Existem animais que foram abandonados por Dangun e vivem secretamente no mundo humano. Nara, uma estudante comum do ensino médio, descobre a existência deles… Uma versão moderna de A Bela e a Fera com comédia e ação de exorcismo.

‘O projeto de se tornar humano, para os animais que não puderam se tornar humanos, será bem-sucedido?’

In a world where technology and magic are almost indistinguishable from one another, monsters and creatures of myth and legend reign terror upon mankind. In humanity’s darkest moment, individuals with special god-like powers emerge to save the day. They are — the Awakened.

Meet Jaehyeon, a feeble Awakened human Raider, who struggles to make ends meet until one day a series of confounding events allow him to claim a powerful item that will change the course of history forever…

description.en:
Elena, who spent her entire life as a cold-blooded female knight to avenge her family, ended up dying without claiming her revenge. When she opened her eyes she found that she went back into the past. By day she was a lady in a dress, and at night she carried a sword to change history and prevent her family's destruction.  
  
"I want to marry you, Your Highness," she said to the crown prince. She would do this to save her family.
description.id: Elena, yang menghabiskan seluruh hidupnya sebagai seorang ksatria wanita berdarah dingin untuk membalaskan dendam keluarganya, akhirnya mati tanpa menuntut balas. Ketika dia membuka matanya, dia menemukan bahwa dia kembali ke masa lalu. Pada siang hari dia menjadi seorang wanita bangsawan, dan pada malam hari dia membawa pedang untuk mengubah sejarah dan mencegah kehancuran keluarganya. "Saya ingin menikahi Anda, Yang Mulia," katanya kepada putra mahkota. Dia akan melakukan ini untuk menyelamatkan keluarganya.
description.ko:
과거로 돌아온 여자. 그리고 그녀가 살려야 할 남자! 

평범한 백작가 영애로 살아가던 "이레나". 그녀의 가문은 반왕 "파벨루크"로 인해 하룻밤 만에 숙청당하고 만다. 
가족의 복수를 위해 냉혹한 기사로 살아가던 그녀는 무슨 이유에서인지 과거로 되돌아가게 되었다. 

가족을 끝까지 지키기 위해선 지난 생에서는 죽었던 황태자 “칼라일”을 살려야 한다! 
더 가까운 거리에서 그를 지키기 위해 중대한 결심을 하게 되는 이레나. 

"저는 전하와 결혼하고 싶습니다." 
"이거 하나만 잊지 마. 내게 먼저 다가온 것은 그대였음을." 

낮에는 레이디, 밤에는 검을 든 기사로 바쁘게 오가는 이레나. 이번에는 미래를 바꿀 수 있을까?!
description.pl: Elena Blaise dorastała jako córka hrabiego w rojalistycznym domu popierającym księcia Carlisle. Nagłe zabójstwo księcia toruje drogę antykrólowi Pavelucowi, który z dnia na dzień unicestwia ród Blaise. Jako jedyna ocalała, Elena szkoli się na rycerza, aby pomścić swoją rodzinę. Kiedy w końcu staje twarzą w twarz z Pavelucem, śmiertelny cios nie tylko pozbawia ją przytomności, ale także katapultuje ją w przeszłość! Elena budzi się rok przed upadkiem rodu Blaise. Zdeterminowana, by chronić swoich krewnych, rzuca się na ratunek księciu koronnemu Carlisle'owi, prosząc go o rękę i oferując swoje usługi jako jego rycerz. Zdezorientowany Carlisle przyjmuje przynętę. Przyszłość leży teraz w rękach jego narzeczonej walczącej w jego imieniu!
description.ru: Ирена — рыцарь, жившая лишь ради мести за свою семью, встретила смерть от рук того, кто был виновен в погибели её рода. Открыв глаза, она обнаружила, что вернулась в прошлое. Днём она леди, носящая пышные платья, а ночью воин, хладнокровно использующий оружие для достижения своей цели: Ирена стремится изменить историю и предотвратить уничтожение её семьи.

description.en:
Hong Il-tak, the only red spot at Daemun Namgo. Despite his name and nickname, he's a boy, and his dwarfism and peculiar appearance have led to him being looked down upon by everyone from the nerds to the elders, and he's at the bottom of the school hierarchy. 

In the past, until his sophomore year, Iltak had been a famous member of the Iljin, but a problem of his own brought him to the bottom of the food chain... 

"His secondary sexuality. If only he'd come to me...!" 

After enduring daily teasing and bullying because his body stopped growing like his peers, Hong Il-taek thought of a way to move up in the ranks... 

"If I can befriend this guy, who's in the second grade at Dae-moon Boys' High School, I'll be able to move up again!" 

But for some reason, Lee Hyun-woo tries to keep his distance from Hong Il-taek... Can Hong Il-taek find his former glory again?

description.en:
“Please, Hilise. Please die in place of Gabrielle.”

My always dignified brother begged me for the first time. He wants me to die for our stepsister, whom we don’t even share a drop of blood with.

“For the first and last time, I ask you this.”

I’ve always been miserable, and there is no exception this time. The seventh time that I was betrayed and killed, I was completely free of lingering feelings.

“I’m glad that you’re a scumbag until the end.”

I won’t be swayed by love anymore. It’s my turn to abandon them first.

---
Noblewoman Hillis Inoaden has had many lives so far (seven, to be exact) but she has always been regarded the same in all of them: meek, submissive, and a pest. But in her eighth resurrection, she no longer bends to the nobles that encircle her, nor does she continue to live in the shadows of her wicked brother and stepsister. With a sacred power passed down from her lineage and the title of Family Head, she sets out for revenge and to change the grave destiny that awaits her.

description.fr:
"Hillis, je t'en supplie, meurs à la place de Gabrielle." Untouchable Lady dépeint l'histoire de Hillis qui vit sa mort à plusieurs reprises tout en planifiant sa vengeance. 

Ricardo, un noble, supplie sa soeur Hillis de mourir pour sauver leur demi-soeur Gabrielle, avec qui elle ne partage pas la moindre goutte de sang. Hillis comprend qu'elle n'a jamais été aimée autant que cette dernière. Après être morte sept fois, et pour tenter d'échapper à son tragique destin, la douce et timide Hillis laisse place à une version d'elle implacable et avide de vengeance !
description.it:
“Per favore, Hilise. Per favore, muori al posto di Gabrielle.” Il mio dignitoso fratello mi ha supplicato per la prima volta. Vuole che muoia per la nostra sorellastra, con la quale non condividiamo nemmeno una goccia di sangue. "Per la prima e l'ultima volta, ti chiedo questo." Sono sempre stata infelice, e questa volta non c'è eccezione. La settima volta che sono stata tradita e uccisa, ero completamente libera dai sentimenti persistenti. "Sono contenta che tu sia spazzatura fino alla fine." Non sarò più influenzato dall'amore. È il mio turno di abbandonarli per primo.

---
La nobildonna Hillis Inoaden ha avuto molte vite finora, sette, per l'esattezza, ma è sempre stata considerata la stessa in tutte: mite, sottomessa e un elemento da evitare. Ma nella sua ottava resurrezione decide di non piegarsi più ai nobili che la circondano, né continua a vivere all'ombra del suo malvagio fratello e della sorellastra impertinente. Con un potere sacro tramandato dal suo lignaggio e il titolo di Capofamiglia in eredità, parte per la sua vendetta e per cambiare il grave destino che l'attende.

After spending nine years on Dungeon and Stone, the role-playing game that no player has ever beaten, Lee Hansoo finally reaches the dungeon of the final boss.

As soon as he opens the gate, however, he suddenly sees a message that says his tutorial has been completed and finds himself in the body of Bjorn Yandel, a real barbarian within the game.

description.en: Baphomet is the ruthless, dispassionate lord of the Abyssal Tower, a mysterious, monster-filled dungeon plaguing the human world. Many Hunters seek to defeat him and bring the tower down to no avail. Despite his demonic power, Baphomet grows curious about humanity. One day, Baphomet is defeated by Raven, the strongest Hunter, and realizes that his true wish is to be just like the humans he previously looked down on. In death, he is granted his wish, as he awakens as a human – without his powers!

Lorsqu’il s’est lassé de ces combats répétitifs, il a commencé à s’intéresser au monde de l’humanité grâce aux trophées qu’il avait obtenus des chasseurs morts.

Dans le même temps, il fut de plus en plus fasciné par l’existence des humains lorsque le puissant chasseur dont il avait toujours rêvé apparut devant lui.

Finalement, Baphomet essaie de devenir lui-même un humain…

description.en:
With 99 nations conquered and the cup of the ruler in her hands… you'd think she was off to a heroic conquest, but the great queen's Cecia's real concern was her uncomfortable corset?  
  
The queen of Valencia suffered from complicated laces and heavy corsets, and thus ordered her trusted brother, Duke Ennon Lionheart to bring her a comfortable clothes.  
  
Meanwhile, Yuri, a clothing designer was killed in an accident after suffering from a small minimum wage at a medium-sized clothing company in Korea. She was reborn in a medieval country ruled by Cecia.  
  
Yuri vowed to revolutionize the outdated clothing dilemma, so she dressed up as a man and worked as a designer at the top of the continent's highest court to do easy business.  
  
But… what happens when Ennon discover's Yuri's true identity…?

description.en:
Wild and carefree by day, heart breaker by night. the beautiful Hae-sul one day wakes up in the body of an empress of an unfamiliar world. As she navigates her new life in the palace she must stay alert to stave off assassination attempts on her life while also juggling the temperamental and childish emperor who has no love for her.

---
A beautiful flirt whose blatant honesty comes off as harassment, Shin Hae-seol, a college student living life to its fullest.

But somehow, she wakes up as the "Empress" in a strange place. She is required to be elegant, beautiful, graceful, and dignified as an example to the other women of the country. To make things worse, she isn't allowed to leave her husband (the emperor) who spends his days having flings with concubines. However, hope comes down from the sky in the form of a mysterious message.

"If you kill the royals, I will send you back to your original world!"

description.ko:
바람둥이, 미남밝힘증,희롱과 솔직 사이에 아슬하게 걸친 노골적 말투까지.
체대생 장학생신해설은 가부장적관점에서 본다면뒷목을잡고넘어가기딱 좋은,
그런 여자다.

그런데 웬걸.어느 날 눈을 떠보니 처음 듣는 나라의 황후가 되어버렸다?!

'황후'로서 뭇 여인들에게 모범을 보이기 위해
얌전, 고상,우아,품위,인내 등등을 요구 받는 생활.
이혼 청구도 못할남편이란 놈에게는 후궁들이 득실거리는데,
암살자란 놈들은 죽어라고 달려드니 이걸 어째.

하지만 하늘이 무너져도 솟아날 구멍은 있는 법!
끊임없이 암살자를 보내던 배후는 해설에게 제안한다.
황족들을 죽이면 본래의 세상으로 돌려보내 주겠노라고!

description.en:
Overflowing wealth, exceptional looks. Ilya Bloden's life was perfect.

Until she witnessed her fiancé's affair, that is.

"I changed everything, my taste, my hobbies, I accommodated his every wish… But I won't live like a pushover any longer. I'll get a perfect break up!"

For the perfect break up, she finds a new fiancé, Karhan Evantheon. She tried to shield herself with Karhan's fearsome reputation, but…

"I found this flower on the battlefield, and I really wanted Illya to see it."

Turns out, he was a cute puppy?! Will this engagement be okay?

---
Money can’t buy her love, but it can help her get sweet, sweet revenge.
Take a seat at Lady Ilya Bloden’s table and watch Ilya charm her way out of a loveless engagement, help the “Bloodthirsty Butcher of the Battlefield’' find the courage to speak to the manager, and single-handedly destroy one of the most influential families in the Ishtar Empire.
Tea and crumpets will be served!
description.id: Hidup Ilia Bloden bisa dibilang sempurna dengan harta yang berlimpah dan paras yang menawan. Namun, kesempurnaan itu hancur karena perselingkuhan tunangannya. Untuk membatalkan pertunangan itu, Ilia memutuskan untuk mencari tunangan baru. Saat itulah ia bertemu dengan Karhan Evantheon, pria yang dikenal menyeramkan. Tapi, kenapa sifat aslinya berbeda 180 derajat? Apa pertunangan ini akan baik-baik saja?
description.ko:
넘치는 재력, 빼어난 외모.
일리아 블로든의 인생은 완벽했다.

약혼자의 바람을 목격하기 전까지는.

"취향, 취미, 내 모든 걸 바꾸고, 바라는 모든 걸 들어줬는데... 더 이상은 호구처럼 살지 않을 거야. 파혼해 주겠어!"

완벽한 파혼을 위한 새로운 약혼자, 카르한 에반테온.
카르한의 무시무시한 소문을 방패로 삼으려 했는데...

“연무장에서 발견한 꽃인데, 일리아에게 꼭 보여주고 싶었습니다.”

알고 보니 순둥한 강아지였잖아?! 이 약혼, 괜찮겠지?
description.pl: Przed ślubem jej narzeczony miał romans. Więc ma nowego narzeczonego, z którym musi zerwać… Ale jest mały problem. [Powiedziałeś, że był zabójcą?] [Krąży plotka, że jest wrakiem.] [Niektórzy ludzie zemdleli, bo podczas rozmowy przestraszyli się.] Lilia wpatrywała się w swojego nowego narzeczonego, który niósł ze sobą najróżniejsze złe plotki. Karhan, trzymając w ramionach małego szczeniaka, spuścił wzrok, jakby miał zostać skarcony. „Lilia…. Zabrałem tego szczeniaka, ponieważ na zewnątrz padał deszcz. …Czy te zaręczyny były dobrym pomysłem?
description.uk:
Перед весіллям наречений зрадив її. Тож вона знайшла нового, щоб розірвати шлюб... Проте є маленька проблема.

— Ти казала, що він убивця?

— Ходять чутки, що той божевільний.

— Деякі втрачали свідомість від страху, спілкуючись із ним.

Ілія втупилась у свого нового нареченого, про якого розносили всілякі брудні чутки.

Кархан, що тримав на руках мале цуценя, опустив очі, ніби його збиралися сварити.

— Іліє... Я підібрав цуценятко, бо на вулиці дощить.

Що із цими заручинами не так?..

description.en:
I entered the world of a novel suddenly. I thought that I could return to reality by falling in love, but death was what awaited me in the end. Defenestration, strangulation, poisoning, drowning, and burning to death... Even after dying a hundred times and returning, the novel still doesn't end...

Karen Haier, who greets her 117th birthday trapped within a novel, now decides to become a murderer.
description.fr:
Elle s’est réveillée dans un roman.
Si elle arrive à trouver le véritable amour, alors elle pourra avoir sa fin heureuse.
Cependant, après la fin de l’histoire, ce qui l’a accueillie, c’est la mort.
Et lorsqu’elle a rouvert les yeux, elle était revenue au début de l’histoire.
Elle est tombée amoureuse encore une fois, mais la fin qui l’attendait, était toujours la mort.
Poison… strangulation… maladie… chute… renversée… immolée… affamée à en mourir…
Alors qu’elle fêtait son 117e anniversaire, Carynne Hare décida de devenir une meurtrière.
description.uk:
Карен потрапила в книгу і подолала всі незгоди, зустріла своє кохання. Розплющивши очі, дівчина опинилася на початку свого шляху - в саду, де завжди йшов дощ. Одного разу Карен спало на думку: найсильніше людей турбує не кохання, а смерть. Її охопило хвилювання. Почуття набридли і у свій 117-й День народження вона вирішила стати вбивцею.

Увага! Тайтл 16+.  Ми не несемо відповідальність за ваш емоційний стан. Присутні удушення, відруб голів і море крові, різні.
description.pt-br:
Fui reencarnada para um livro. Se eu encontrasse meu verdadeiro amor, minha vida teria um final feliz. No entanto, quando a história chegou ao fim, o que me cumprimentou foi a morte.

Quando ela abriu os olhos, ela se viu no início de tudo. Ela decidiu se apaixonar de novo. Envenenamento, estrangulamento, queda, doença, morte por esmagamento, morte por queda, morte de… Depois de comemorar seu aniversário de 124 anos, Karen Haier decidiu se tornar uma assassina.

description.ar:
تعيش سيليستيا في الزقاق الخلفي لجولددينا ولديها مهارة يمكنها تبديد السحر. إنها تعتقد أن مهارتها غير مجدية وتدعم صديقتها الموهوبة سيرينجيفان بدلاً من ذلك. "احصل على تلك القطعة المجنونة!" لكنه خانها وباعها على أنها عاهرة على الرغم من وعدهم بالزواج. في يأسها الذي لا مفر منه ، ظهر رجل بدا أنه نبيل أمام سيليستيا ورؤية حالته ، تقترح عليه سيليستيا صفقة. "يمكنني أن أشفي المرض الذي تعاني منه." "...أين سمعت عني؟" كان وجه الرجل يخيف بشكل متزايد لكن سيليستيا أرادت أن تعيش. حصلت في النهاية على ما أرادت ، ووصلت إلى مكان يشبه القصر الإمبراطوري. "في المستقبل ، اتصل بي" صاحبة الجلالة ". "... جلالة الملك؟" "بالطبع ، أنا الإمبراطور الوحيد لإمبراطورية بورغ ، فان." والمثير للدهشة أن هوية الرجل هي ... إمبراطور إمبراطورية بورغ ، المعروف باسم مختل عقليًا ذو عيون حمراء. أصبحت سلستيا واحدة من رعايا الإمبراطور. هل تستطيع النجاة بأمان؟

description.de:
Eine junge Frau wird von ihrem Ex-Verlobten als Sklavin verkauft. Gegen ihren Willen muss sie ihren kleinen kranken Bruder zurücklassen. Als sie die Hoffnung auf Rettung fast verloren hat, trifft sie auf einen jungen Adeligen, der etwas Besonderes in ihr sieht: Eine Person, die sein Leiden heilen kann und in deren Gegenwart er zur Ruhe kommt. Er nimmt sie mit sich in seinen Palast, damit sie für ihn arbeiten kann. Die Frau ist so dankbar, dass sie alles Erdenkliche tut, um die neue Sekretärin ihres Befreiers zu werden, welcher nicht nur irgendein Adeliger ist, sondern der König eines fremden Landes!

description.en:
Celestia lives in the back alley of Golddina and has a skill that can dispel magic. She thinks that her skill is useless and supports her talented friend Serengevan instead.

"Get that crazy b'tch out!"

But he betrayed her and sold her as a slave even though they promised to get married. In her inescapable despair, a man who looked to be a nobleman appeared before Celestia and seeing his condition, Celestia proposes a deal to him.

"I can heal the disease you are suffering from."

"…Where did you hear about me?"

The man's face was getting increasingly scary but Celestia wanted to live. She eventually got what she wanted, and arrived at a place which resembled the imperial palace.

"In the future, call him 'Your Majesty.'"

"…Your Majesty?"

"Of course, he's the one and only Emperor of the Burg Empire, Van."

Surprisingly, the identity of the man is… The Emperor of the Burg Empire, known as the Red-Eyed Psychopath. Celestia became one of the emperor's subjects. Can she survive safely?

---
Celestia was in love and dreaming of a brighter tomorrow until, out of the blue, her fiancé cheated on her and left her for dead. Suddenly, she was alone with nothing. Enter the Emperor, cold and aloof with unlimited power and wealth. He was alone with everything. But now these two have each other. Her cunning and courage make her invaluable to him, and yet it’s the secret they share that makes them inseparable... and a target for those who crave power. Will their relationship remain professional, or will it become something magical?

description.fr:
Vendue en esclavage par son ami d’enfance et ex-fiancé, une jeune femme laisse contre son gré son jeune frère souffrant. Tout semble perdu pour elle quand elle croise le chemin d’un jeune noble! Possédant une capacité de guérison hors norme dont il a tant besoin, elle arrive à négocier avec lui sa liberté. Ainsi, elle le suit jusque dans son palais et va tout faire pour devenir la secrétaire de celui qui pourrait bien être... l'empereur d’un pays étranger.

---
Celestia vivait dans les bas quartiers de Goldina, au milieu des rues étroites remplies de terre, où des mendiants y traînaient comme des cadavres.

Elle possède un talent rare qui permet de dissiper la magie et pense filer le parfait amour avec son ami d'enfance, Serek. Mais celui-ci la trahit et la vend en esclavage. En route vers le marché où elle sera vendu, elle rencontre un noble et passe un accord avec lui; «Je peux guérir la maladie dont vous souffrez.»

Tant bien que mal, elle réussit à se sauver, mais... «À l'avenir, appelle-moi 'Votre Majesté'.». L'identité de cet homme n'est autre que Van, l'Empereur de Burg. C'est donc ainsi que Celestia devient le sujet du psychopathe aux yeux rouges...

description.it:
Celestia, che vive a Goldina, ha l'abilità di annullare la magia. Dopo essere stata tradita da chi più amava, viene venduta come schiava. È proprio nel momento di maggior disperazione che incontra un uomo che sembra essere un nobile. Con lui stringe un accordo: lo guarirà dalla sua malattia in cambio del suo aiuto a riottenere la libertà. L'uomo accetta e la porta con sé al palazzo imperiale. "In futuro, mi chiamerai sua Maestà." Sorprendentemente, quell'uomo è in realtà il re dell'Impero di Burg, conosciuto anche come "lo psicopatico dagli occhi rossi"... Riuscirà Celestia a sopravvivere?

description.ru:
Селестия живёт на заднем дворе Голддины и имеет способность, отменяющюю магию. Она считает свою способность бесполезной и своего талантливого друга Серенгебана. "Избавьтесь от этой поехавшей!" Но он предал её и продал в рабство, несмотря на обещание брака. Внезапно перед ней появился благородно выглядящий мужчина, и, увидев его состояние, Селестия предложила ему сделку. "Я могу излечить то, от чего Вы так страдаете". "Откуда тебе об этом известно?" Лицо мужчины становилось всё злее, но Селестия хотела жить. В итоге она добивается своего и оказывается во дворце, похожим на имперский дворец. "В дальнейшем обращайся ко мне "Ваше Величество". "……Ваше Величество?" "Разумеется. Я - единственный Император Бургской Империи, Ван!" Оказалось, что этот человек… Правитель Бургской Империи, известный, как Красноглазый Психопат! Селестия стала одной из его подданных, Сможет ли она теперь выжить?

description.tr:
Celestia Golddina’nın arka sokağında yaşıyordu ve büyüyü defedebilen bir yeteneğe sahipti.Yeteneğinin işe yaramaz olduğunu düşünür ve onun yerine yetenekli arkadaşı Serengevan’ı desteklerdi.“Şu deli orospuyu dışarı çıkartın!”Ama o ona ihanet etti ve evlenme sözü vermelerine rağmen onu köle olarak sattı.Onun kaçınılmaz çaresizliğinde, asilzade olan bir adam Celestia ve onun durumunu görmeden ortaya çıktı, Celestia onunla bir anlaşma yapmayı teklif etti.“Acı çektiğin hastalığı iyileştirebilirim.”“…Beni nereden duydun?” Adamın yüzü giderek korkunçlaşıyordu ama Celestia yaşamak istiyordu.Sonuç olarak istediğini aldı, ve imparatorluk sarayını andıran bir yere vardı.“Gelecekte, bana ‘Majesteleri’ diye seslen.”“…Majesteleri?”“Elbette, ben Burg İmparatorluğu’nun ilk ve tek imparatoru, Van.”Şaşırtıcı bir şekilde, adamın kimliği…Burg İmparatorluğu’nun imparatoru, Kırmızı-Gözlü Psikopat olarak da bilinir.Celestia, imparatorun tebaalarından biri oldu.Güvenli bir şekilde hayatta kalabilecek mi?Kralın sekretere ihtiyaç duymasının nedeni…

description.en: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful king who was merciless and greedy. Upon taking a look at his life record, God shook his head. God asked the three women who suffered greatly because of the king, “What punishment would you like him to receive?” Then, the three women, glancing at one another, answered all at once. “Please send all of us back to Earth.”
description.ko:
까마득한 옛날, 아름답고 무자비했으며 탐욕스러운 왕이 있었다.
그의 생전 기록을 들여다본 신은 고개를 내저었다.
그리고 왕에게 가장 고통 받았던 세 여인에게 신은 물었다. 

"너희는 그에게 무슨 형벌을 내리기를 바라느냐?"

그러자 서로를 바라본 세 여인이 잠시 후 일제히 대답했다.

"저희 모두를 다시 지상 세계로 내려보내주십시오."

세 여인에 의하여 아름다운 외모와 뛰어난 검솜씨,
그 누구도 사랑하지 않는 강철의 심장을 빼앗긴 채 환생을 하게된 지엔.

그리고 그녀 앞에 남자로 환생을한 전생의 여인들이
차례차례 나타나기 시작하면서 네 사람의 악연은 반복 되기 시작하는데……!

"왜 똥을 싼 것은 전생의 자신인데 엿을 먹는 것은 현생의 자신인가!"
